summary: Build 17 VaultPass product ID reconciliation verified on web preview (mobile viewport 375x667, frontend-only per request). Code sweep first: `grep` across /app/frontend/src and /app/backend confirmed every VaultPass SKU reference now reads 'app.vaultpop.vaultpass.plus.monthly' (shop-screen.tsx L59/L226, settings-screen.tsx L40, monetization/catalog.ts L78, monetization/economy.ts L78) with zero remaining occurrences of the old bare 'app.vaultpop.vaultpass.monthly'. Live UI checks: (1) SIGNED-OUT /shop -> 'Currently Unavailable' disabled button, testID shop-vaultpass-unavailable caption 'VaultPass is unavailable right now. Please try again later.', testID shop-catalog-retry-button present, testID shop-vaultpass-diagnostics NOT rendered. (2) ADMIN (qa.owner.b15@vaultpop.test) /shop -> shop-vaultpass-diagnostics text EXACTLY: 'Requested app.vaultpop.vaultpass.plus.monthly — store session unavailable (StoreKit requires a native iOS build).' -> contains new 'app.vaultpop.vaultpass.plus.monthly' = TRUE; after masking the new id, residual substring 'vaultpass.monthly' present = FALSE (confirmed the old bare id does NOT leak through). Retry Loading Products re-runs the catalog load — diagnostics + unavailable caption remain, no crash/blank/loop. (3) PLAYER (qa.player@vaultpop.app) /shop -> shop-vaultpass-diagnostics NOT rendered; unavailable + retry still present as expected for non-admin. (4) Regression: DAILY REWARDS, BOOSTER FORGE, COIN PACKS sections all render on /shop; admin /account still shows OWNER TOOLS + testID account-admin-console-button; tapping it navigates in-app to /admin-console (URL: /admin-console) which renders 'Admin Console' title + testID admin-console-open-button. Sign-out and sign-in as player works. StoreKit inert on web preview is BY DESIGN (native-iOS only). No new bugs introduced by the SKU rename. Deprecated `pointerEvents` and `textShadow*` prop console warnings persist from prior iterations (non-blocking, already reported in iterations 6/7).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Carry-over from iteration 6/7; non-blocking.
Console warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Non-blocking; caught during shop/account renders.
Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation.' Expected on web (no RCTAnimation module); native iOS builds unaffected.
